title: Emergency containment runbook + roadmap for Dedicated capacity shortfall caused by kernel-selection regression
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Summary: During a production incident on 2025-11-02 a regression in kernel selection logic caused sustained CPU/GPU inefficiency in several Dedicated pools, producing a 35-60% throughput shortfall for affected SLAs. This ticket captures the emergency containment runbook, immediate remediation steps completed, the technical root cause analysis, and a prioritized roadmap of follow-ups to prevent recurrence and improve observability/controls for Dedicated fleets.

Goals: 1) Provide a clear, operable runbook for on-call and SRE to rapidly contain and restore throughput when kernel-selection or similar execution-path regressions occur. 2) Track and deliver short/medium-term mitigations (admission control, emergency rollback, synthetic canaries, and autoscale policy hardening). 3) Land long-term fixes in runtime (kernel selector heuristics, perf regression detection, and capacity-safety circuits).

Impact: customer-facing throughput drop for Dedicated customers on specific model classes (Llama2-70B fp16 quantized variants) between regions us-west1 and eu-west1; incidence window ~2025-11-02 23:10 -> 2025-11-04 04:30 UTC. No data exfiltration or confidentiality breach. Several high-commit Dedicated contracts reported increased error budgets and one support escalation to CS/AE.

Immediate containment actions performed: 1) Emergency admission-control engaged (throttle low-priority routes, admission policy applied to dev/test workloads). 2) Automated fallback to previously pinned kernel-profile (rollback tag: runtime-kernel-2025-10-29) across affected pools. 3) Applied temporary conservative autoscale thresholds: increase headroom factor from 15% to 40% for provisioned pool groups. 4) Re-routed traffic for high-SLO customers to alternate region and dedicated reserve pools.

Root cause (summary): A change in the kernel-selection scoring introduced on 2025-10-28 (PR #4281) altered preference ordering such that the runtime selected a lower-throughput kernel for sequences >2k tokens on certain GPU models. The selector's telemetry sampling was sparse for these combinations so the perf regression wasn't flagged during CI canaries.

Short-term roadmap (next 2 weeks): - Ship runbook doc and make it discoverable in /playbooks/dedicated-capacity. - Add admission-control quick-toggle in Console for SRE/Oncall. - Backfill telemetry to sample kernel-performance at higher frequency for tail sequences and add an alert when P50/P95 token throughput drops >20% vs baseline. - Introduce synthetic canary runs that exercise long-sequence kernels nightly.

Medium-term roadmap (1-3 months): - Rework kernel-selection scoring to include stability penalty and hysteresis. - Autoscale policy guard rails: add minimum headroom floor and fast-path emergency provisioning. - Expand dedicated capacity chaos tests to include intentional kernel mis-selection scenarios. - Post-release QA gating: require perf regression checks for kernel/selector PRs.

Acceptance criteria: - Runbook accepted by SRE and Runtime leads and published. - Console toggle implemented and tested in staging. - Telemetry alert fires in a simulated regression test. - One follow-up RFC accepted for kernel-selector algorithm changes.

Owners: runtime lead (Ethan Morris) for kernel fixes; SRE lead (Olivia Chen) for runbook/run testing; Console PM (Marta Ruiz) for toggle; Observability (Devon Patel) for telemetry and alerts.
comments: 2025-11-04 — Initial triage note: observed throughput delta on dedicated pools at 23:08 UTC. Oncall engaged admission-control and started traffic re-routing. Logged error budgets for three high-tier customers. — Asha

2025-11-05 — Identified suspect PR runtime#4281 that changed kernel selection defaults. Reverted selector config in canary; throughput restored. Preparing emergency rollback across affected pools. — Ethan

2025-11-07 — Emergency rollback completed (runtime-kernel-2025-10-29). Post-rollback telemetry shows P95 token latency back within SLA band. Customer-facing incident report drafted and sent to CS. — Asha
2025-11-10 — Draft runbook created (playbook v0.1). Requested SRE and Runtime review. Includes steps: detect, isolate, rollback, admission-control, re-route, escalate. — Ethan

2025-11-13 — SRE review comments: add clear decision criteria for when to trigger cross-region re-route and include cost/contract impact note. Also request a one-click Console toggle for admission-control. — Olivia

2025-11-16 — Telemetry plan: increase kernel telemetry sampling by 5x for long sequences; add a Grafana alert for throughput regression >20% sustained for 10m. Also queued synthetic canary job cron in staging. — Devon

2025-11-18 — RFC draft for kernel-selector heuristics posted for review: introduces stability penalty and 3-epoch hysteresis. Performance simulation attached in RFC. Deadline for feedback: 2025-11-24. — Ethan

2025-11-20 — This ticket moved to In Review. Runbook updated per SRE feedback; Console quick-toggle prototype in internal staging; telemetry alert validated in synthetic run. Next: finalize RFC and schedule patch release. — Asha
